summary: Teams create and submit a comprehensive social media marketing campaign for the Riverside Rockets, a fictional minor league baseball team. The campaign must include strategies for community engagement, content calendars, sponsorship promotion, geo-targeted advertising, a detailed budget with ROI estimates, and measurable success metrics. Teams present their campaign virtually to judges and are scored on both their written submission and oral presentation.
time_limits: Setup: no more than three (3) minutes
Presentation: no more than ten (10) minutes
Judges’ questions: no more than five (5) minutes
Presentation will be stopped at ten (10) minutes
submission_requirements: Submit one combined PDF file containing the Social Media Marketing Campaign, Works Cited formatted according to the Style & Reference Manual, BPA Release Form(s), and AI Usage and Documentation Form
Team ID is required for all submissions
Only the team captain should complete the submission
deadlines: Event registration deadline: no later than 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on December 1, 2026
Submission deadline: January 15, 2027, 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time
competencies: Develop a comprehensive written social media marketing campaign that integrates strategy, content planning, and measurable goals aligned to business objectives
Demonstrate effective oral and written communication skills, including the ability to present research, information, and persuasive content in a clear and professional manner
Identify and utilize internal and external resources to support campaign planning, content development, and marketing execution

Identify and analyze the target customer base — including consumer buyer personas, organizational markets, and demographics — and demonstrate how content strategy is informed by and aligned to audience needs
Develop and execute effective content creation strategies across relevant social media platforms, ensuring consistency, engagement, and alignment with campaign goals
Utilize fixed financial resources strategically within a marketing environment to maximize campaign reach and impact
Demonstrate an understanding of how digital marketing influences and responds to shifts in consumer demographics and behavior
Demonstrate the teamwork skills required to collaborate effectively and perform at a high level in a professional, world-class workforce environment

rubric.criterion: Team followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.

Team submitted one (1) combined PDF file containing the Social Media Campaign, Works Cited formatted according to the Style & Reference Manual, BPA Release Form(s), and AI Usage and Documentation Form.

rubric.description: Provides a compelling and strategic overview of the campaign.
Offers a vivid and engaging description that enhances understanding.
Objectives are strategic, measurable, and aligned with campaign goals.
Content is highly engaging, original, and tailored to the audience.
Strategy is innovative, cohesive, and well-integrated across platforms.
Budget is detailed, realistic, and strategically allocated.
Metrics are comprehensive, actionable, and aligned with objectives.
Document is visually polished and enhances readability and engagement.

rubric.criterion: Team followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage and Citation Policy.

rubric.description: Team is highly confident, expressive, and fully engages the audience throughout.
Thoroughly explains and connects all phases of development to project objectives.
Provides detailed, insightful explanation of innovative tools and techniques used.
Offers a comprehensive and engaging explanation of asset creation and integration.
Provides a thoughtful and detailed explanation of team collaboration and responsibilities.
Presentation style is polished, dynamic, and powerfully enhances audience understanding and engagement.
Responses are detailed, insightful, and effectively address the judges' questions.

judging_notes: Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level.
Materials submitted for technical judging will not be returned and will not be available at NLC.
Props and/or additional items shall not be used as a basis for scoring.
Presentation will be stopped at ten (10) minutes.
eligibility_notes: Any middle level, secondary or postsecondary contestant may enter this event.
A team will consist of 2-4 contestants.
There are no restrictions on the number of entries per chapter or per state.
Teams who do not submit an entry following the topic listed below, do not follow the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and the Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy will be disqualified.
Contestants participating in the competition must be registered for the event prior to the submission deadline to be eligible.
